{{Infobox auto|title=Prayer of Aeolus|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Prayer of Aeolus''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that gives [[Anemos]] and {{MCW|Wind Burst}} I. It is the only craftable source of Anemos, and is crafted from seven {{MCW|Wind Charge|wind charges}} and a {{MCW|Block of Gold|block of gold}}.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/wind_burst_anemos.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Prayer of Aeolus" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Prayer of Aeolus is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Anemos applies to swords and sticks, while Wind Burst applies only to {{MCW|Mace|maces}}, so no single item can use both enchantments from one book. Anemos is forbidden on maces. Applying the book to a sword gives Anemos; applying it to a mace gives Wind Burst.

In 1.12.2 the book does not store Anemos itself but <code>main:anemos</code>, the enchantment's id before the pack moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace. Its tooltip line reads "ERROR: Please hold me to update".<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/main/enchantment/anemos.json}}</ref> The old enchantment does nothing by itself, but the first tick the sword is held in the main hand, it is replaced with Anemos.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/main/item_modifier/update_anemos.json}}</ref> It can be applied to wooden, stone, iron, diamond and netherite ([[Adamant Sword|adamant]]) swords and to sticks, but not to copper swords, even though Anemos itself supports them.

== Trivia ==
* Aeolus is the keeper of the winds in Greek mythology, matching the wind charges in the recipe and the wind-based enchantments.
